_readme: Default discovery configuration for ProxyPulse. Sources are opt-in on purpose:
only fetch lists that are publicly available AND whose publisher permits automated
collection, and keep request volume modest (one fetch per source per refresh cycle).
See config/sources.example.json for ready-to-enable public providers, and
docs/DEVELOPMENT.md for the fields this file accepts.

sources.note: Small curated list used by the tests and the offline demo (`npm run demo:local`).
